For a soy sauce substitute that maintains the savory, umami profile of a stir-fry while being soy-free, coconut aminos are an excellent choice. They offer a similar salty-savory flavor with a slightly sweeter, milder taste. Alternatively, you can use tamari if the allergy is strictly to soy proteins but not gluten, though coconut aminos are safer for severe soy allergies. Another option is a mixture of beef or mushroom broth with a splash of vinegar and a pinch of salt to mimic the depth of flavor.
